scenes.sense: A small round object rolling repeatedly
scenes.description: A plain ball on a gently sloping grassy hillside, with curved ground trails suggesting its rolling path.
The same person chooses the blue cup, then the red cup, then the blue cup again across three otherwise similar panels.
A person laughs brightly beside a smiling companion at a kitchen table.
A round-bellied puppy sits on a light rug, its compact outline and fluffy coat clearly visible.
